# Description
A [Primity](https://modrinth.com/mod/primity) flint tools reskin to match the [Excalibur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/excal) resource pack. Changes Primity's flint tools textures to more matching Excalibur textures
# Dependencies
[Primity](https://modrinth.com/mod/primity) by [Baunilla](https://modrinth.com/organization/baunilla)
